question:
‘The volume of a right circular cylinder is 814 cm³. If the radius and the height of the cylinder are equal. find the height (in cm) of the cylinder.

(Use pi = (22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of cylinder V = π × r² × h

Given r = h, ∴ V = π × h³

814 = (22/7) × h³

h³ = 814 × (7/22) = 37 × 7 = 259

h = ³√259 cm

**∴ The correct option is C.**
